Additionally, each stage can operate as either a compressor or, by dialing in Ratio values below 1:1, an expander. Altogether this makes for phenomenally versatile control over the volume and loudness of your mixes, stems and parts.

Another innovative feature of BLEASS Multiband Compressor is its flexible sidechain system.
